hints.title: Delimiter-Robust Serialization
hints.text: Strings in the list may contain any of the 256 valid character codes, including commas, colons, or quotes. How can length prefixes make message framing independent of content?

hints.title: Length-Prefixed Chunk Framing
hints.text: Prefix each string with its character length followed by a non-numeric delimiter like a hash symbol: length + "#" + string.

hints.title: Linear Chunk Parsing
hints.text: During decoding, scan until finding the hash symbol to parse the chunk length L. Slice the exact next L characters as the string, then advance pointer past the chunk.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total number of characters across all strings in the list
complexity.notes: Encodes and decodes with a single linear pass over the characters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simple delimiter splitting fails whenever strings contain the delimiter itself.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores minimal integer prefix metadata per string.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling empty strings, empty lists, and strings containing digits and delimiters.
